title: fix: block requests from overdrawn wallets
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Preflight now requires a positive balance in at least one bucket (Quest > 0 or Paid > 0) before the estimate check; a wallet in debt with no positive bucket gets 402 on every model, including free ones
- A positive Paid balance still covers a negative Quest balance, so users recover by purchasing
- Root cause: #13512 changed the coverage check from `>` to `>=`, so a 0 paid balance "covered" a 0 estimate. Estimates read as 0 whenever the Tinybird `public_model_stats` fetch failed (empty result cached in KV for 1h), which became frequent after #13467 made the pipe heavier on Aug 22. Aug 22–25: 12,718 overdrawn calls, 210 users, ~226 Pollen of Quest debt, one wallet to −134
- Behaviour change: accounts at exactly 0/0 can no longer call zero-priced community endpoints (including owners calling their own private model) until they hold some Pollen
- Not addressed: truly concurrent requests can still each incur one debt charge before any settles; the empty stats result is still cached for the TTL (no longer a billing hole)
- Tests: full gen suite 606 passed; the two `elevenlabs-*` failures reproduce on `main`

gist.headline: No more bottomless pollen pots
gist.blurb: The billing garden now checks that a wallet has some pollen before opening the gate. Paid Pollen can still help a Quest balance climb back out of the compost heap.
gist.summary: Updated generation preflight checks so wallets need a positive Quest or Paid Pollen bucket before requests proceed, preventing zero-cost estimates from allowing overdrawn accounts to continue generating.
gist.impact: Accounts with a positive Paid balance can continue using models even if their Quest bucket is negative, while empty 0/0 wallets now need to hold Pollen before calling community or private endpoints.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is a careful garden keeper inspecting two labeled pollen jars, Quest and Paid, beside a cozy API gate; a small positive Paid jar helps a drooping Quest plant recover while the gate only opens for jars with pollen. Use flowers and code-plants to make wallet balance checks feel like tending a shared garden.
